name: Burst of Strength
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, paladin 2, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You speak a word that empowers you to smash most obstacles.

When you cast this spell you gain a +10 bonus to Strength checks made to break objects. At caster level 10 or higher this spell grants a +20 bonus instead.
